tagline: Leading self-storage operator in the United States with over 3,100 facilities
hero_kpi_rationale: Net operating income is a key indicator of the company's financial health in the real estate sector, reflecting its ability to generate revenue after direct operating costs.

kpis.name: Net Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Net cash provided by operating activities
kpis.description: Net operating income is a key indicator of the company's financial health.

kpis.name: Same Store Net Operating Income Change
kpis.explanation: Change in net revenue generated by the same stores compared to the prior year.
kpis.description: The $15.3 million decline in net operating income from comparable stores reflects pressure on rental rates for new tenants and a decrease in average occupancy in 2025.

kpis.name: Non-Same Store Net Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Net cash provided by non-comparable stores and newly developed sites
kpis.description: The $68.4 million increase in operating income primarily stems from the impact of facilities acquired in 2025 and 2024.

kpis.name: Same Store Operating Expenses Change
kpis.explanation: Change in operating expenses related to comparable stores.
kpis.description: The 1.8% or $16.6 million increase in operating expenses primarily stems from higher property tax expenses and indirect operating costs.

kpis.name: Cumulative Acquisitions Since 2023
kpis.explanation: Total value of installations acquired since the beginning of 2023.
kpis.description: Since the beginning of 2023, the company has acquired 273 facilities with 19.9 million square feet of leasable space for $3.9 billion.
kpis.signal: Significant investments in facility acquisitions since 2023

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K)

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net Income — bottom-line profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL for the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Operating Income — profit from core business operations.
kpis.description: Operating income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL for the last 6 reported fiscal years (10-K).

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Dividend Per Share — total dividends paid divided by shares outstanding.
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend cut risk, monitor payout sustainability

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.explanation: Capital Return — total cash returned to shareholders (dividends + buybacks).
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 reported fiscal years.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Payout Ratio — dividends paid divided by net income.
kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Shareholder returns growing, dividend policy supportive

stories_kpis.name: Net Operating Income 2025
stories_kpis.explanation: Net cash provided by operating activities in 2025
stories_kpis.description: Net operating income is a key indicator of the company's financial health.
stories_kpis.signal: Decline in net operating income in 2025

ai_positioning.summary: The company PSA does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and data breach
risks.summary: A cybersecurity breach could compromise customer data and damage the company's reputation.
risks.score_rationale: Risk is explicitly mentioned at the top of risk factors with strong language ("adversely affect"). It concerns the protection of confidential information, essential for client relationships in real estate. The cybersecurity category is critical for companies managing large customer databases. The risk is stable compared to the prior year.

risks.title: Deterioration in comparable sites performance
risks.summary: Existing facilities are experiencing performance deterioration with declining occupancy and rising costs.
risks.score_rationale: The document indicates declining demand, lower average occupancy, and rising operating costs for Same Store Facilities. These factors reflect direct operational pressure on profitability. The language is factual but concerning, with negative trends over two consecutive years. The risk is increasing.

risks.title: Sensitivity to economic conditions and interest rates
risks.summary: Asset valuations and future profitability are highly dependent on economic conditions and interest rates.
risks.score_rationale: The text mentions that assumptions on discount rates, capitalization rates, and future rental income significantly influence asset valuations. While not explicitly stated as a standalone risk, it arises from critical accounting estimates. The macro category is moderately weighted. The risk is stable.

risks.title: Dépréciation et amortissement croissants
risks.summary: The continuous increase in depreciation expenses reduces net profitability despite operational growth.
risks.score_rationale: Amortization expense increased by $22.1 million in 2025, following a $159.7 million increase in 2024. This weighs on net income despite NOI growth. The risk is recurring and linked to the aggressive acquisition strategy. The language is neutral, but the numbers speak for themselves. The risk is stable.

risks.title: Perte de change significative
risks.summary: The company incurs significant losses related to foreign exchange fluctuations, particularly on its euro-denominated debt.
risks.score_rationale: A foreign exchange loss of €317.8 million significantly impacted net income in 2025. This amount is material and directly linked to euro-denominated debt. The risk is clearly quantified and sudden, indicating an uncovered currency exposure. The risk is either new or significantly heightened.

risks.title: Concentration géographique des actifs
risks.summary: A high concentration of assets in a few states increases exposure to regional risks.
risks.score_rationale: Nearly 40% of the square footage is located in three states (Texas, California, Florida), exposing the portfolio to localized climate or regulatory risks. Although not explicitly mentioned as a risk, this emerges from property data. The risk is stable.

risks.title: Coûts d'exploitation en hausse
risks.summary: Rising costs, including taxes, are compressing margins on existing installations
risks.score_rationale: Comparable-site operating costs increased by 1.8% in 2025, primarily due to property taxes. This trend is pressuring operating margin. The risk has been repeated for two consecutive years, with factual but concerning language. The risk is stable.

governance.voting_structure_note: Single class of common stock, 1 vote per share.
